entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker of Zendikar who helped trap Ulamog, tries to complete the broken ring with her own body, then is cut off from Zendikar by Kozilek's spawn.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and planeswalker with a reignited spark who breaks the hedron prison, calls Kozilek, and leaves Nissa isolated and Gideon drowned.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and invulnerable commander who fights Ob Nixilis to protect Jace and is drowned in mud.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker who speaks into Nissa's mind and creates mirror-image illusions; he is struck down by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Nissa's elemental and the soul of Zendikar, who cracks and crumbles when the prison fails.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan released from the hedron prison and moving toward Sea Gate again.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: A second Eldrazi titan called up by Ob Nixilis whose field warps reality and the leylines.

entities.name: Kozilek's spawn
entities.description: Eldrazi spawn of Kozilek that Ob Nixilis borrows to cut Nissa off from Zendikar.

entities.name: Zendikari
entities.description: The people and army of Zendikar defending Sea Gate.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien invaders including titans and spawn.

entities.name: Hedron prison
entities.description: A ring of hedrons and leylines that briefly trapped Ulamog and collapses.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: A heart of the world that Ob Nixilis once uprooted on Bala Ged.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane being torn apart by two titans.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city and seawall where the final stand takes place.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A continent ravaged by Ulamog where Nissa first fought the demon.

events.summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
events.quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

events.summary: Nissa calls on Ashaya, but Ashaya cracks and crumbles and the world shakes.
The seawall heaves, the hedron ring shakes, and a stray hedron with dark power breaks a leyline.
Nissa tries to complete the broken circle with her own body but is struck down by Ulamog's tentacle.
events.quote: Nissa only saw the thick, pink tentacle after it had struck her.

events.summary: The rest of the ring collapses and Ulamog, free again, moves toward Sea Gate.
events.quote: Ulamog, free of his bonds, was moving toward Sea Gate once more.

events.summary: Nissa recognizes the demon from Bala Ged as the cause of the collapse as he casts a great spell.
events.quote: He was the cause of all of this.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis calls a second titan, Kozilek, up from the ground.
events.quote: The demon had called yet another horror to ravage her world.

events.summary: Nissa surrenders to rage and runs at the demon through Kozilek's distortion and the toppling lighthouse.
events.quote: Kozilek's flailing arm had smashed into the seawall

events.summary: Nissa tackles Ob Nixilis with her blade at his neck, but he escapes and drains her with essence magic.
events.quote: sending a tide of his essence-draining magic down at Nissa.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis uses spawn of Kozilek to cut Nissa off from Zendikar and the leylines.
events.quote: She was cut off from Zendikar. Powerless.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis senses a telepath in his head and strikes down Jace, breaking his cheekbone.
events.quote: my fist broke his cheekbone instead of taking his head off as I'd intended.

events.summary: Gideon tears Ob Nixilis's wing and confronts him, declaring the people under his protection.
events.quote: These people are under my protection, demon.

events.summary: Gideon and Ob Nixilis fight, and Ob Nixilis breaks the telepath's confidence in Gideon and kills six stragglers.
Gideon breaks Ob Nixilis's knee with a joint lock, but the demon pins him.
events.quote: The knee cracked and a sickening jolt pulsed through my body.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis drowns Gideon in muddy water, and Gideon's body goes limp.
events.quote: Invulnerability proved no match for three inches of dirty water.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis calls himself the enemy she deserves.
relations.quote: now I feel obliged to be the enemy you deserve.

relations.note: Nissa swears to end the demon.
relations.quote: For that, and for everything else, she would end him.

relations.note: They fight and Ob Nixilis drowns him.
relations.quote: This is Zendikar," I whispered. "And your fight is over.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek up from beneath Zendikar.
relations.quote: The demon had called yet another horror to ravage her world.

relations.note: Ashaya is Nissa's friend whom she calls to the land.
relations.quote: Ashaya!" Nissa ran for her friend

relations.note: Gideon defends Jace, striking Ob Nixilis to save his friend.
relations.quote: He was willing to strike me from behind to save his friend
